projects.title: SiteSense — Intelligent Web Navigation
projects.subtitle: RAG-Powered Conversational Discovery & Autonomous Routing
projects.problem: Navigating information-dense web portals is often tedious, resulting in user drop-off when searching across deep hierarchical documentation and pages.
projects.solution: Built an intelligent RAG-based AI assistant that semantically parses website content, answers queries in real time, and automatically routes users directly to the precise target destination.
projects.description: RAG-based AI system engineered for intelligent website querying, vector search, semantic retrieval, and autonomous page redirection to streamline information discovery.
capabilities: Vector embedding & semantic indexing of web content
Contextual query resolution with low-latency LLM pipeline
Intelligent multi-page navigation and autonomous redirection
Clean conversational interface with direct citation links

projects.title: Altuno — AI Finance Management App
projects.subtitle: Cross-Platform Smart Expense Analytics for Students
projects.problem: Students struggle with financial literacy and manual expense tracking due to fragmented apps that lack automated categorization and actionable spending telemetry.
projects.solution: Architected a responsive cross-platform mobile application powered by React Native and Firebase that offers real-time cloud data sync, automated expense categorization, and monthly analytics.
projects.description: Cross-platform mobile application built using React Native and Firebase for real-time synchronization, intelligent expense categorization, income tracking, and monthly financial analytics tailored for student users.
capabilities: Real-time bi-directional cloud data synchronization via Firebase
Automated expense categorization and monthly budget telemetry
Multi-device transaction logging and instant income tracking
Mobile-first responsive architecture designed for student usability

projects.title: AI Powered Legal Chatbot
projects.subtitle: Interactive Legal Assistant with 3D Avatar & LLM Reasoning
projects.problem: Legal jargon and statutory research are inaccessible and overwhelming for non-lawyers seeking immediate guidance on rights and regulations.
projects.solution: Engineered an AI-powered legal assistant combining an interactive 3D avatar with large language model reasoning and specialized legal document processing for intuitive real-time advisory.
projects.description: AI-powered legal assistant project with 3D avatar. Designed an AI-powered legal assistant integrating a 3D avatar and LLM for real-time legal resolution. Combined NLP, legal data processing, and immersive UI to enhance accessibility in legal tech.
capabilities: NLP-driven statutory reasoning and query interpretation
Interactive 3D avatar UI for conversational legal consultation
Structured parsing and indexing of legal statutes
Real-time conversational streaming and query assistance
